card.name: Injection preparation and administration text
card.fires_on: Words inside intravenous injection instructions, mostly the word 'whenever' in the stock sentence about inspecting parenteral products. It also fires on odd spots such as the gap after a temperature range, 'of' before extravasation, and the middle of 'Gangrene' or 'promethazine'.

modes.label: Visual inspection sentence
modes.description: The word 'whenever' in 'inspected visually for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration, whenever solution and container permit'.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration,<< whenever>> solution and container permit.

modes.label: Injection warning and dosing details
modes.description: Scattered spots in IV administration and tissue-injury text, such as inside 'Gangrene', 'promethazine', 'Dextrose', or a number in an infusion time.
